text: The Article resolves agent identity by legal stipulation rather than metaphysics: the legal subject is the registered record, continued by a recorded learning update within a prescribed granularity or by a recorded continuity transition, and only while the signing key stays within the registered configuration.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Should an Intelligent Agent Have Legal Rights? (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7596939

isBasedOn.name: Should an Intelligent Agent Have Legal Rights?

abstract: Should intelligent agents have legal rights? This Article sets that question aside and asks a smaller one that matters more in practice. An intelligent agent that earns a reputation record has something to lose.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: recorded learning update within the prescribed granularity, or a recorded continuity transition
signing key remains within the registered configuration

additionalProperty.name: supporting_quote
additionalProperty.value: The Article fixes the legal subject by rule: it is the registered record.
